wins.label: Strong EPS growth and capital returns
wins.evidence: diluted earnings per share up 16% from a year ago...returned $4.8 billion of capital to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases

wins.label: Consent order progress reducing management burden
wins.evidence: 5 consent orders were terminated in the first quarter...11 orders have been terminated since 2019

wins.label: Fee revenue diversification succeeding
wins.evidence: grew our fee-based revenue across many of our businesses, reflecting the benefit of the investments we've been making to diversify revenues

wins.label: Credit performance improving
wins.evidence: credit performance improved during the quarter with lower net charge-offs...net loan charge-off ratio down 5 basis points from a year ago

wins.label: First loan growth in two years
wins.evidence: first time we have seen growth in average loans since first quarter 2023

risks.label: Net interest income pressure and uncertainty
risks.evidence: we currently expect our full-year 2025 net interest income to be in the low end of the range...huge unknowns...volatile time

risks.label: Economic uncertainty and potential slowdown
risks.evidence: we will face continued volatility and uncertainty and are prepared for a slower economic environment in 2025...less affluent customers show more stress

risks.label: Trade policy and tariff risks
risks.evidence: there are certainly risks associated with such significant actions, and we see concern playing out in the markets and the economic uncertainty that now exists

risks.label: Asset cap limiting balance sheet growth
risks.evidence: we have limited our ability to grow, the ability to finance customers and our trading businesses and associated inventory

risks.label: Venture capital portfolio volatility
risks.evidence: impairments in the venture capital portfolio...that number can be a little volatile quarter-to-quarter
